title: Workflows Page Redesign — Operational-First UX
description: Complete redesign of /workflows and /workflows/:id around operator workflows. Default landing is operational (what's running now), secondary is design (editing definitions). Kills standalone /runs route. Four user intents: (1) what's running/stuck, (2) investigate a failed run, (3) create/modify workflow, (4) trigger a run manually. Three main zones: Active Runs strip, Workflow Templates list, and a detail page with Run History + DAG Visualizer + collapsible Definition editor.
architectureNotes:
**Reuse:** ReactFlow for DAG (existing WorkflowBuilder nodes), useAllRuns/useRuns hooks, RunStatusBadge, WebSocket stream, useApprovals mutations.

**New components:** ActiveRunsStrip (horizontal scroll, attention-first ordering), DAGRunOverlay (ReactFlow nodes with run state), NodeDetailPanel (slide-out for step inspection), RunNowModal (schema-to-form + dry-run), SuccessSparkline (tiny inline chart from run history).

**API gaps:** (1) Dry-run simulation HTTP endpoint wrapping Safety Kernel Simulate(), (2) workflow success rate aggregation (client-side from last N runs for now), (3) step-level approval action (reuse existing job approval by jobId from step metadata).

**URL structure:** /workflows (templates + active runs strip), /workflows/:id (detail with DAG), /workflows/:id/runs/:runId (pre-selected run in DAG).

**Real-time:** WebSocket events update DAG nodes live — step_completed → green, step_failed → red, approval_required → yellow pulse. Active runs strip also live-updates.
epicRails: No metrics/analytics charts on this page — that's Command Center
In-context approvals: approve/reject directly from DAG node detail panel
Schema-to-form rendering for Run Now modal — not raw JSON
Attention-first ordering: stuck/failed runs surface before healthy ones
Collapsible workflow definition — 80% of visits are about runs not editing
WebSocket-driven live updates for DAG nodes and active runs strip
